name: n4_connect
description: Open a session to one of the stations the operator configured at server start (replaces any previous session). The URL, credentials and TLS policy are fixed by the operator and cannot be chosen here. The station's real stationName must equal expected_station (default: the configured station NAME), or the session is closed. With expected_version (e.g. 4.14 or 4.14.0.162), the detected version must equal it or start with it by whole dotted parts (4.14 matches 4.14.0.162, 4.1 does not), or the session is closed; an undetected version never matches. Reports the detected version (oBIX productVersion) and its tier: A (4.13/4.14) writes; B (4.15/4.3) and C (other or unknown) refuse writes unless the operator opted the station in. If the station later drops the session (e.g. a restart: Could not find Server Session), a read or dry run reconnects once with these arguments and is retried once, and a second loss in a row is reported; a write execution is not retried: it answers session lost, redo the dry run.

expected_station.description: Required stationName; default: the station NAME

expected_version.description: Optional version the station must report: the full version or a dotted prefix (4.14 matches 4.14.0.162); a mismatch or an undetected version closes the session
